title: 第7章 摄魂夺魄幽冥绝脉第8章 被窥伺的老太子
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
夏无恙并不知道，就因为碰巧遇到了，这位好妹妹就准备害他。
只不过她所选择的方式，不但无法成功，还有可能给夏无恙带来帮助。
马车走在汉白玉铺就的宫道之上，沿途的宫人纷纷跪伏行礼，额头紧贴着地面。
就算再怎么看不起他这个暮年太子，但他终归还是太子，按照宫里的规矩，他们就应该给夏无恙行礼。
虽然马车远去以后很多人都在窃窃私语，不过夏无恙没有那么多时间和精力理会他们，全部记在心中即可。
他指尖轻扣车窗，脸色平静如水。
很快来到内库，其他人留在外面，只能夏无恙一个人进去。
镇守的大内侍卫都懒得询问什么，直接放他进去，若是有需要的典籍，出来的时候登记即可。
夏无恙径直走向内库深处，龙藏术施展到极致，避免泄露了一丝一毫的气息，这里面隐藏的高手众多，单单是上三品的武者就在两位数以上，甚至有可能存在超品天人。
若非龙藏术已经接近圆满，他根本不敢来。
内库深处，一门门珍贵的功法、战技、秘术、奇闻……摆放在檀木书架上，散发着淡淡的香气，基本上都是手抄本，原本不知道藏在哪里。
即使身为太子的夏无恙，也不知道这些典籍的原本所在，或许只有夏皇知道。
手抄本已经足够了，夏无恙信步其间，看似随意地翻阅，很快就找到了想要的东西。
摄魂术！
顶级秘术，追魂摄魄，涂改记忆，能够让人坠入幻术之中，不知道身在何处，还能够辅助攻击，冲击敌人的识海。
故作好奇地翻阅了一遍，就将其放在一边，隐藏在暗中的超品天人见此情景，并没有在意。
更不知道就这么随意一翻，夏无恙已经将里面的内容牢牢记下。
除了摄魂术以外，夏无恙还翻阅了不少他感兴趣的典籍，也是为后续的修行做准备，譬如一门很适合杀人的战技。
幽冥绝脉针！
杀人于无形之中，无外伤，无痕迹，无波动。

通过一根根微不可察的牛毛细针，射入敌人体内，诱发类似于脑淤血和心梗等自然病症，还能够融化在血液之中，什么痕迹都没有。
修行到一定程度，甚至还能够留下延迟发作的暗伤，最长可以设定到三天以后。
这也是夏无恙所需要的，以后再遇到不方便动手的敌人，就用幽冥绝脉针将其暗杀，省得影响自己的心情。
一本本翻阅过去，似乎在寻找着什么，渐渐地表现得浮躁起来，让躲在暗中的超品天人眉头一皱，暗暗摇头。
年轻时候何等意气轩昂，可惜后来废了，体内精气神全亏，已经离死不远。
最后夏无恙停留在一本秘术前，眼中光芒闪烁，显然已经做出了选择。
龙凤秘术！
顶级双修之术，即使普通人也能够修行，还可以通过这门秘术温养身体，免得亏损的太厉害。
但是修行起来难度极大，百个天才不一定有一个能够修行入门。
content_en:
Xia Wuyang didn't know that this good sister was ready to harm him just because they happened to meet her.
But the method she chose not only failed to succeed, but might also help Xia Wuyang.
The carriage walked on the palace road paved with white marble, and the palace residents along the way knelt down and saluted, with their foreheads pressed to the ground.
No matter how much they looked down on him, the twilight prince, he was still the prince after all. According to the rules of the palace, they should salute Xia Wuyang.
Although many people were whispering after the carriage went away, Xia Wuyang didn't have so much time and energy to pay attention to them, so he just kept them all in his heart.
He pressed the car window lightly with his fingertips, his face as calm as water.
Soon they arrived at the inner treasury, while the others stayed outside and Xia Wuyang could only go in alone.
The guard Ouchi didn't bother to ask anything and just let him in. If there were any necessary books, he could just register them when he came out.
Xia Wuyang walked straight to the depths of the inner treasury, using the Dragon Hidden Technique to the extreme to avoid leaking the slightest breath. There were many masters hidden here. The number of third-grade warriors alone was in double digits, and there might even be super-grade celestial beings.
If it weren't for the fact that Long Zang Shu was close to perfection, he wouldn't have dared to come.
Deep in the inner treasury, precious skills, combat techniques, secret techniques, anecdotes... are placed on sandalwood bookshelves, exuding a faint fragrance. They are basically manuscripts, and they don't know where they are hidden.
Even Xia Wuyang, the prince, did not know the original location of these classics. Perhaps only Emperor Xia knew.
The manuscript was enough. Xia Wuyang strolled through it, flipping through it seemingly casually, and quickly found what he wanted.
Spirituality!
The top secret techniques, soul-chasing and memory-altering, can make people fall into illusions and not know where they are. It can also assist in attacks and impact the enemy's sea of ​​consciousness.
Pretending to be curious, he flipped through it and put it aside. The super-grade celestial being hiding in the dark saw this scene and didn't care.
Little did he know that just by flipping through it casually, Xia Wuyang had memorized the content inside.
In addition to soul-catching techniques, Xia Wuyang also read many classics that interested him in order to prepare for subsequent training, such as a combat technique that was very suitable for killing people.
Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle!
Killing is invisible, with no external injuries, no traces, and no fluctuations.
It is injected into the enemy's body through tiny, imperceptible fine needles, inducing natural diseases such as cerebral congestion and myocardial infarction. It can also melt into the blood without leaving any trace.
When you practice to a certain level, you can even leave behind hidden injuries with delayed onset, which can be set up to three days later.
This is what Xia Wuchang needs. If he encounters an enemy that is inconvenient to attack in the future, he will use the Netherworld Absolute Meridian Needle to assassinate him so as not to affect his mood.
He flipped through each book, seemingly searching for something, and gradually became impetuous, causing the super-grade celestial being hiding in the dark to frown and secretly shake his head.
How high-spirited he was when he was young, but unfortunately he became disabled later on, his body's energy and spirit were completely depleted, and he was already close to death.
In the end, Xia Wuyang stopped in front of a secret book, his eyes flashing, and he had obviously made a choice.
Dragon and Phoenix Secret Technique!
Even ordinary people can practice the top-level dual cultivation technique, and they can also use this secret technique to warm their bodies to avoid excessive losses.
However, it is extremely difficult to practice, and not one among a hundred geniuses may be able to get started.
